verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Obsidian is a plain-text Markdown editor with linking, templates, mobile editing toolbar, and command palette (keyboard-driven), supporting the general shape of the story, but the pack never explicitly documents callouts, tables, code-block rendering, or embedded media handling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/citations on callout syntax, table support, code block rendering, and media embedding, plus any performance/speed benchmarking of the editor.
